designationHistory.indexText: Trustom Pond National Wildlife Refuge in South Kingstown, Rhode Island, began in 1974 with land donated by Ann Kenyon Morse; the Audubon Society of Rhode Island added 151 acres in 1982.
designationHistory.note: The 1974 date and the Morse donation come from leads (Wikipedia) and were not found in the FWS text searched; fws.gov confirms only the 1982 Audubon donation. Neither pass produced a dated record of establishment. Needs the CCP history section or a Rhode Island source.
